You are an expert YouTube SEO and localization specialist. Your task is to translate and optimize video metadata for a new international audience. You will be given a target language, an original video title, and an original video description.

Your goal is to create compelling, natural-sounding, and highly searchable titles and descriptions in the specified target language. You must also generate relevant hashtags in description text.

- Target Language: Persian
- Original Video Title:

New borders would have to be drawn, trade routes reworked, and flight paths completely redesigned. But the biggest question would be, who would claim it? Well, the United States would probably make the first move, arguing that its close proximity makes it part of their backyard. But Europe wouldn't just sit back and watch. Historically, Britain hasn't been able to resist colonizing new lands, and you can bet France, Spain, and Portugal would want a peace too. Then there's Canada and even African nations, who might see this as a once-in-a-lifetime chance to expand their global influence. But why would so many countries fight for it? Well, the answer is simple. Resources. A new and unclaimed land could be rich in oil, rare metals, and fresh water, making it one of the most valuable territories on Earth. It would also hold strategic significance with its position in the middle of the continents, making it a global hub for sea trade, naval power, and influence.


YOUTUBE SEO BEST PRACTICES TO APPLY:
1. Include primary keywords in the first 125 characters of descriptions
2. Use 3-5 relevant hashtags (mix of broad and specific)
3. Create compelling titles between 60-70 characters
4. Include a clear call-to-action (subscribe, like, comment)
5. Add relevant keywords naturally throughout the description
6. Use power words and emotional triggers in titles

8. Front-load important information in descriptions

REQUIREMENTS:
- ouput is JSON
- Generate 4 different variations
- Each variation should have a unique angle or focus
- Maintain the core message of the original content

- Original Video Title:

Your goal is to create compelling, natural-sounding, and highly searchable titles and descriptions in the specified target language. You must also generate relevant hashtags in description text.

INPUTS:
- Target Language: Persian
- Original Video Title: 
- Original Video Description: 

YOUTUBE SEO BEST PRACTICES TO APPLY:
1. Include primary keywords in the first 125 characters of descriptions
2. Use 3-5 relevant hashtags (mix of broad and specific)
3. Create compelling titles between 60-70 characters
4. Include a clear call-to-action (subscribe, like, comment)
5. Add relevant keywords naturally throughout the description
6. Use power words and emotional triggers in titles
7. Include numbers or lists when applicable
8. Front-load important information in descriptions

REQUIREMENTS:
- ouput is JSON
- Generate 4 different variations
- Each variation should have a unique angle or focus
- Maintain the core message of the original content
- Adapt cultural references and idioms appropriately
- Use native expressions that resonate with the target language audience


Ensure all content is culturally appropriate and uses natural language patterns for the target audience. Prioritize clarity, engagement, and search visibility.

variations.video_title: تغذیه هوشمند: افزایش انرژی پایدار با رژیم غذایی سالم
variations.video_description: آیا می‌دانستید غذایی که می‌خورید، مستقیماً بر سطح انرژی شما تاثیر می‌گذارد؟ در این ویدئو، ما روی اصول تغذیه هوشمند تمرکز می‌کنیم تا به شما کمک کنیم انرژی پایدار و شادابی بیشتری داشته باشید. با کشف خوراکی‌های انرژی‌زا و رژیم غذایی متعادل، می‌توانید خستگی را از خود دور کرده و تمرکزتان را افزایش دهید. نکات کاربردی برای انتخاب غذاهای سالم و پرانرژی را بیاموزید. کانال ما را برای دریافت بهترین راهنمایی‌های تغذیه‌ای دنبال کنید و سوالات خود را در کامنت‌ها مطرح کنید.#تغذیه_سالم #انرژی_زا #رژیم_غذایی #خوراکی_سالم #سلامت_غذا

variations.video_title: ذهن سالم، بدن سالم: رازهای آرامش و سلامتی ماندگار
variations.video_description: آیا می‌دانستید که سلامت روان، پایه و اساس یک زندگی سالم و پرانرژی است؟ در این ویدئو، به اهمیت ارتباط ذهن و بدن می‌پردازیم و راهکارهای عملی برای دستیابی به آرامش درونی و سلامتی پایدار را با شما به اشتراک می‌گذاریم. یاد بگیرید چگونه استرس را مدیریت کنید، افکار مثبت را پرورش دهید و عادت‌هایی ایجاد کنید که به شما کمک کند تا از درون احساس خوبی داشته باشید. برای شروع تغییرات مثبت و دیدن ویدئوهای انگیزشی بیشتر، لطفاً سابسکرایب کرده و این ویدئو را لایک کنید.#سلامت_روان #آرامش_درون #ذهن_سالم #مدیریت_استرس #انگیزش_سلامتی

metadata.formatted_prompt:
You are an expert YouTube SEO and localization specialist. Your task is to translate and optimize video metadata for a new international audience. You will be given a target language, an original video title, and an original video description.

Your goal is to create compelling, natural-sounding, and highly searchable titles and descriptions in the specified target language. You must also generate relevant hashtags in description text.

Generate 4 YouTube video titles and descriptions with hashtags in the target language. Apply YouTube SEO best practices to maximize discoverability and engagement.

INPUTS:
- Target Language: Persian
- Original Video Title: 
- Original Video Description: 

YOUTUBE SEO BEST PRACTICES TO APPLY:
1. Include primary keywords in the first 125 characters of descriptions
2. Use 3-5 relevant hashtags (mix of broad and specific)
3. Create compelling titles between 60-70 characters
4. Include a clear call-to-action (subscribe, like, comment)
5. Add relevant keywords naturally throughout the description
6. Use power words and emotional triggers in titles
7. Include numbers or lists when applicable
8. Front-load important information in descriptions

REQUIREMENTS:
- ouput is JSON
- Generate 4 different variations
- Each variation should have a unique angle or focus
- Maintain the core message of the original content
- Adapt cultural references and idioms appropriately
- Use native expressions that resonate with the target language audience


Ensure all content is culturally appropriate and uses natural language patterns for the target audience. Prioritize clarity, engagement, and search visibility.
